basis: Planning model only. PostgreSQL compute uses the previously verified us-east-1 price of 0.016 USD/hour; storage uses 0.115 USD/GiB-month. The SES feedback worker uses Secrets Manager and SNS interface endpoints in two AZs at a 0.01 USD/endpoint-AZ-hour planning rate, before data processing. The persistent full-AWS staging target exceeds the approved ceiling, so deployment must fail closed until costs are reduced or the owner changes the cap.
